p: sacrifices with strife: For where there were many sacrifices, there were many portions given to the people, with which they feasted.
inheritance among the brethren: That is, will be made governor over the children.
turneth: The reward has great force to gain the hearts of men.
friends: He that admonishes the prince of his fault makes him his enemy.
messenger shall be sent against him: By the messenger is meant such means as God uses to punish the rebels.
a fool in his folly: By which he means the wicked in his rage, who has no fear of God.
price in the hand of a: What good does it do the wicked to be rich, seeing he does not set his mind to wisdom?
brother is born for adversity: So that he is more than a friend, even a brother that helps in time of adversity.
gate seeketh destruction: Lifts up himself above his degree.
bosom to pervert the ways of: That is, secretly and out of the bosom of the rich.
ends of the earth: That is, wander to and fro, and seek not after wisdom.
for equity: For their well doing.
